texts.zh: 短暂的冲突之后，我方付出了数人伤亡的极小代价，[This.ContactCountry.GetName]探索船的船员们——我们现在知道他们是[This.ContactCountry.Species.GetAAnSpeciesClass][This.ContactCountry.Species.GetClass]物种——向我们的接舷小队投降。我们现在同时扣押了它们的舰船，以及船员作为人质，可以进行审问工作并学习它们的科技。
texts.en: After a brief struggle in which we sustained minimal casualties, the crew of the exploratory vessel of the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] - who we now know to be [This.ContactCountry.Species.GetAAnSpeciesClass] [This.ContactCountry.Species.GetClass] species - surrendered to our boarding party. We now hold both their ship and a large portion of their crew hostage, and can set to work interrogating them and studying their technology.

texts.zh: 经过短暂的交锋，我们保持了伤亡最小化，来自[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的探索船只的船员向我们的登船部队投降。在船上有多种不同的外星物种，但是最主要的似乎是[This.ContactCountry.Species.GetClassPlural]。我们现在人船俱获，现在可以开始审讯他们以及期待获得他们的科技。
texts.en: After a brief struggle in which we sustained minimal casualties, the crew of the exploratory vessel from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] surrendered to our boarding party. There were multiple different alien species onboard, but the majority of them seem to have been [This.ContactCountry.Species.GetClassPlural]. We now hold both their ship and a large portion of their crew hostage, and can set to work interrogating them and their technology.

texts.zh:
当我们登陆上[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的探索船上时，眼前的景象始料未及——船员居然都是机械体无人机，而且看上去被一个失控的人工智能管制！在短暂的交火之后，我们成功无力化了足够数量的无人机，仅剩些许残余仍在抵抗。令人惊讶的是，它们并没有启动自毁程序——我们只能假设自己的运气很好，在它们的管制人工智能下达自毁命令之前，成功切断了信号。

我们现在同时扣押了它们的舰船，以及船员作为人质，我们可以展开研究它们科技的工作，也可以查看这些无人机是否携带任何有用的信息。
texts.en:
As we boarded the exploratory vessel of the [This.ContactCountry.GetName], we were greeted by a surprising revelation - the crew was made up of mechanical drones seemingly piloted by a rogue AI! After a brief struggle, we were able to disable enough of them that the rest ceased to resist. Surprisingly, they did not manage to initiate self-destruct sequences - we can only assume that we were fortunate enough to cut off the signal to their guiding AI before the order was given.

Now that we hold both their ship and what remains of their crew hostage, we can set to work studying their technology, and see whether the drones will yield any useful information.

texts.zh:
短暂的冲突之后，我方付出了数人伤亡的极小代价，我们对[This.ContactCountry.GetName]探索船的船员进行了压制，并迫使它们投降。[This.ContactCountry.Species.GetClass]外星人在战斗中表现出了极强的协同性——就好像受同一思维指挥一样——直到其中一个个体被击毙，它们全员停止了抵抗。自那以后，它们表现出了明显的无目的性和迷惑性。我们只能猜测它们是某个蜂巢主脑控制的子个体们。

我们现在同时扣押了它们的舰船，以及船员作为人质，我们可以研究它们的科技，也可以试试动用审讯手段是否能够查出什么情报出来。
texts.en:
After a brief struggle in which we sustained minimal casualties, we overwhelmed the crew of the exploratory vessel of the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] and forced them to surrender. The [This.ContactCountry.Species.GetClass] aliens fought with remarkable coordination - almost as if guided by a single mind - until as one, they suddenly ceased to resist. Since then, they have appeared aimless and confused. We can only posit that they were drones of some sort of hive mind.

Now that we hold both their ship and what remains of their crew hostage, we can set to work studying their technology, and see any interrogative methods may yield any useful information.

texts.zh:
经过短暂交火，我方仅付出轻微伤亡便成功压制了[This.ContactCountry.GetName]探索舰的船员并迫使其投降。起初这群[This.ContactCountry.Species.GetClass]外星生物展现出远超预期的协同作战能力——宛如共用同一个意识——直到他们突然停止了抵抗。彼时每个船员都丧失了组织性，退化出野蛮的原始行为模式。

我们只能推测这些已近乎丧失智慧的生物曾以某种群体意识形态运作。如今既已将其船员与舰船扣为人质，便可着手审讯这支诡异舰队，并研究其独特科技。
texts.en:
After a brief struggle in which we sustained minimal casualties, we overwhelmed the crew of the exploratory vessel from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] and forced them to surrender. At first the [This.ContactCountry.Species.GetClass] aliens fought with a far greater sense of coordination than we had anticipated - acting as though with one mind - until suddenly, they ceased to resist. At that point each crew member lost all cohesion, instead reverting to brutish, primal behaviors.

We can only posit that these now barely-sapient creatures were operating as some form of gestalt. Now that we hold both them and their ship hostage, we can set to work interrogating this bizarre crew, and studying their unique technology.

texts.zh:
我们的探险家们知道第一次接触是一项很危险的事情，但谁也没想到事态会发展到这个地步。在这次暴力袭击中，[From.Owner.GetName]扣押了我们的舰船，我们还没来得及发动紧急超光速跃迁就被搜查小队登船了。尽管我们的船员做出了英勇的反抗，但袭击者——[From.Owner.Species.GetAAnSpeciesClass][From.Owner.Species.GetClass]，他们还是干烂了我们的防御。

在所有信号切断前，我们收到的最后一条视频显示，敌人活捉了大部分船员，并打算盘问他们，他们可能打算进一步了解我们，为下一步敌对行动做准备……
texts.en:
Our explorers knew first contact to be a dangerous affair, but none could have predicted just how true this would be. In a violent assault, the [From.Owner.GetName] seized our vessel, landing a boarding party before emergency FTL could be engaged. Despite our crew's valiant efforts, the attackers - [From.Owner.Species.GetAAnSpeciesClass] [From.Owner.Species.GetClass] alien species - were able to overwhelm our defenses.

The last visual feeds we received before all signals cut off suggested that the enemy had captured much of the crew alive and were intent on interrogating them, probably with the intention of finding out more about us in preparation for further hostilities...

texts.zh:
风险决策部分从一开始就知道第一次接触外星文明是一项很危险的事情。[From.Owner.GetName]的行动证明了他们是对的。我们的舰船被扣押了，还没来得及发动紧急超光速跃迁就被搜查小队登船了。

这群针对我们的袭击者，[From.Owner.Species.GetClass]的外星人，成功捕获了许多我们的低级子个体；然而，如果不给他们一些必要的指导，他们也不会获得太多——尽管他们能够从被俘的飞船上了解到我们的技术。他们的威胁等级已经被调高了。
texts.en:
The part of us that considers threat assessments was sure from the start that encountering alien civilizations would be risky. This has proven correct with the case of one of our exploratory vessels, which was assaulted and boarded by the [From.Owner.GetName] before emergency FTL could be engaged.

Our assailants, a group of [From.Owner.Species.GetClass] aliens, managed to capture many of our menial drones; however, without us to give them direction, they will probably not give away much of value - though they will be able to find out much about our technologies from the captured ship. Our evaluation of the danger posed by them has accordingly increased.

袭击我们的是一群[from.owner.species.GetClass]外星人，他们俘获了许多滞留在飞船上的[root.GetSpeciesAdj]共生体。既然这些共生体已脱离我们的群体意识，我们怀疑捕获者难以从中获取战略价值。然而它们的离去仍削弱了我们的力量。我们完全有理由感到被冒犯，但同样可以欣慰的是，在这片神秘虚空中，我们又揭露并确认了一个新的威胁。
texts.en:
We had long suspected that if life existed elsewhere in the galaxy it may pose a threat to us, every bit as wild and lethal as rogue singularities or stellar radiation. Now though, our suspicions have proven true. One of our exploratory vessels has been assaulted and boarded by the [from.owner.GetName]; they pressed their attack before our ship-bound symbionts could make their escape.

Our assailants, a group of [from.owner.species.GetClass] aliens, captured many of our now-stranded [root.GetSpeciesAdj] elements on board. As these symbionts are no longer part of our chorus, we doubt their captors will extract much of strategic value. However, by their loss we are still diminished. We would be justified in feeling insulted, but so too might we take heart in having exposed and identified a new threat out in this otherwise enigmatic void.

tooltips.zh: 为了保证安全，我方其他位于他们领土中的舰队也发动了紧急超光速跃迁。
tooltips.en: Our other fleets in what appears to be their territory have sought safety by engaging emergency FTL.

texts.zh:
我们结束了对此前抓获的[This.ContactCountry.GetName]外星人的研究。最初这些人质不太愿意与我们合作，但随着时间推移他们在无意中不断地给了我们有关他们语言的线索，一直到我们能够与他们进行基础的语言交流。从那时起，我们就能迅速拼凑有关他们的细节，一旦有一位或是更多的人质愿意合作，我们就能进入他们的电脑系统。

得益于从他们身上收集到的信息，我们能够确认他们来自[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]，并就其活动和军事实力收集到了相当多的情报。
texts.en:
We have concluded our study of the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] aliens we recently captured. The hostages were initially unwilling to cooperate with us, but over time they inadvertently gave us clues to their language, until we were able to communicate with them on a basic level. From that point, we were rapidly able to piece together further details about them, eventually gaining access to their computer systems once one of the more cooperative hostages cracked.

Thanks to the information we have gleaned from them, we are able to identify them as the [This.ContactCountry.GetRealName] and have amassed considerable intelligence on their activities and capabilities.

texts.zh:
我们结束了对此前抓获的[This.ContactCountry.GetName]外星人的研究。这些人质显然意志薄弱，没什么阻止我们对其调查的想法。事实上，他们十分配合。我们很快就能翻译他们的语言并进入对方的电脑系统。

因此，我们得以确定他们来自[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]，并就其活动和军事实力收集到了相当多的情报。
texts.en:
We have concluded our study of the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] aliens we recently captured. The hostages were remarkably weak-willed and showed no particular desire to keep us from finding out about them; indeed, they proved extremely cooperative. We were soon able to translate their language and access their computer systems.

As a result, we have been able to identify them as the [This.ContactCountry.GetRealName] and have amassed considerable intelligence on their activities and capabilities.

texts.zh:
我们结束了对此前抓获的[This.ContactCountry.GetName]外星人的研究。这些人质表现得极其不愿意配合我们，甚至我们审讯者使用了以往最具有说服力的方法也无济于事。然而，随着时间的推移，他们在无意中不断地泄露出有关他们语言的各种线索，最终使得我们有能力与他们开展基础性的交流。从那时起，我们就可以迅速拼凑出有关他们的细节，此外骇入对方部分基础电脑系统的行动也取得了进展。尽管如此，我们还是怀疑他们对我方隐瞒了大量细节。

得益于我们从他们身上获取的信息，我们得以确定他们来自于[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]，并就其活动和军事力量获取了大量情报。
texts.en:
We have concluded our study of the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] aliens we recently captured. The hostages proved remarkably unwilling to cooperate with us, resisting even the most persuasive methods of our interrogators. However, over time, they inadvertently gave us clues to their language, eventually allowing us to communicate with them on a basic level. From that point, we were rapidly able to piece together further details about them - as well as gain access to some of their basic computer systems - although we suspect that they were able to keep many details back.

Thanks to the information we were able to glean from them, we are able to identify them as the [This.ContactCountry.GetRealName] and have amassed considerable intelligence on their activities and capabilities.

texts.zh:

幸运的是，我们想办法破解了他们的电脑系统的秘钥，[This.Owner.GetLinguists]马上就能翻译他们用来通讯的信号。现在，我们已经能够确认[This.ContactCountry.GetName]是[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]，。我们现在积累了大量有关他们活动和能力的情报。
texts.en:
We have concluded our study of the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] machines we recently captured. Once cut off from their parent AI, the drones lacked agency, and we were able to find out little of use from them as their functionality rapidly degraded.

Fortunately, we were able to crack the codes to their computer systems, and our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] were soon able to translate the signals they use for communication. As a result, we can now identify the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] as the [This.ContactCountry.GetRealName] and have amassed considerable intelligence on their activities and capabilities.

texts.zh:
我们结束了对于此前捕获的[This.ContactCountry.GetName]外星人的研究。看上去它们确实是由蜂巢思维所链接起来的，单独的子个体是缺少自我意识和代理权的。将其从主体意识剥离后，这些子个体似乎漫无目的，然后一个接一个地死去。除了将其作为生物标本外也没什么其他地作用了。

幸运的是，我们想办法破解了他们的电脑系统的秘钥，[This.Owner.GetLinguists]马上就能翻译他们用来通讯的信号。现在，我们已经能够确认[This.ContactCountry.GetName]是[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]，。我们现在积累了大量有关他们活动和能力的情报。
texts.en:
We have concluded our study of the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] aliens we recently captured. It would appear that they are indeed organized as a hive mind, with individual drones lacking autonomy or agency. Cut off from the body, the drones seemed aimless and died off one by one, not yielding much in the way of useful information except as unwitting biological specimens.

Fortunately, we were able to crack the codes to their computer systems, and our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] were soon able to translate the signals they use for communication. As a result, we can now identify the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] as the [This.ContactCountry.GetRealName] and have amassed considerable intelligence on their activities and capabilities.

texts.zh:
我们已经完成了对近期捕获的[This.ContactCountry.GetName]外星生物的研究。这些为数众多的生命体以某种蜂巢思维的方式组织起来，但并没有一个中央的管理实体。相反，这些几乎不具备智慧的个体似乎与它们的整个生物群落形成了一种共生格式塔结构。 由于彼此隔绝且与母星失去联系，这些共生体退化至原始状态并迅速消亡。除了作为解剖对象外，它们没有为我们提供多少有用的信息。

幸运的是，我们想办法破解了他们的电脑系统的秘钥，[This.Owner.GetLinguists]马上就能翻译他们用来通讯的信号。现在，我们已经能够确认[This.ContactCountry.GetName]是[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]，。我们现在积累了大量有关他们活动和能力的情报。
texts.en:
We have concluded our study of the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] aliens we recently captured. This myriad assortment of lifeforms are organized as a sort of hive mind, albeit without a central, governing entity. Instead these barely-sapient individuals seem to form a mutualistic gestalt with their entire biome. Since being isolated from each other as well as their homeworld, these symbionts reverted to a primal state and perished fairly rapidly. They have yielded little useful information to us, save as subjects for autopsy.

Fortunately, we were able to crack the codes to their computer systems, and our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] were soon able to translate the signals they use for communication. As a result, we can now identify the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] as the [This.ContactCountry.GetRealName] and have amassed considerable intelligence on their activities and capabilities.

texts.zh:
我们的探险家们知道第一次接触是一项很危险的事情，但谁也没想到事态会发展到这个地步。在这次暴力袭击中，[From.Owner.GetName]扣押了我们的舰船，我们还没来得及发动紧急超光速跃迁就被搜查小队登船了。尽管我们的船员做出了英勇的反抗，但袭击者——[From.Owner.Species.GetAAnSpeciesClass][From.Owner.Species.GetClass]，他们还是干烂了我们的防御。

我们船上的视觉信号现在已经切断了，但他们已经向我们展示了这些外星人是如何“善待”俘虏和人质的。他们直接活切了人质并取出他们的内脏做研究！我们必须假定，当面对一个以这种方式行事的文明时，我们必须采取强有力的敌对行动。
texts.en:
Our explorers knew first contact to be a dangerous affair, but none could have predicted just how true this would be. In a violent assault, the [From.Owner.GetName] seized our vessel, landing a boarding party before emergency FTL could be engaged. Despite our crew's valiant efforts, the attackers - [From.Owner.Species.GetAAnSpeciesClass] [From.Owner.Species.GetClass] alien species - were able to overwhelm our defenses.

Our visual feeds from within the ship have now cut off, but not before showing us the unspeakable atrocities the aliens are committing against the hostages, cutting them open and studying their insides even while they are still alive! We must assume that hostilities are inevitable when faced with a civilization that would act in such a manner.

texts.zh:
风险决策部分从一开始就知道第一次接触外星文明是一项很危险的事情。[From.Owner.GetName]的行动证明了他们是对的。我们的舰船被扣押了，还没来得及发动紧急超光速跃迁就被搜查小队登船了。

这群针对我们的袭击者，[From.Owner.Species.GetClass]的外星人，设法捕获了我们的许多低级子个体，并且已经开始不顾可能产生的损耗而将它们从生理上拆分开来，显然是在寻找一种方法来让这些子个体对付我们自己。这样的行为，加上他们捕获的我们的舰船和在船上使用的所有技术，他们的威胁等级需要提升到非常高的程度。
texts.en:
The part of us that considers threat assessments was sure from the start that encountering alien civilizations would be risky. This has proven correct with the case of one of our exploratory vessels, which was assaulted and boarded by the [From.Owner.GetName] before emergency FTL could be engaged.

Our assailants, a group of [From.Owner.Species.GetClass] aliens, managed to capture many of our menial drones and have begun cutting them apart with no regard for the waste of resources, apparently seeking to find a way to turn our own biology against us. This, together with their capture of our ship and all the technologies deployed there, has caused us to significantly increase our evaluation of the danger posed by them.

We had long suspected that if life existed elsewhere in the galaxy it may pose a threat to us, every bit as wild and lethal as rogue singularities or stellar radiation. Now though, our suspicions have proven true. One of our exploratory vessels has been assaulted and boarded by the [from.owner.GetName]; they pressed their attack before our ship-bound symbionts could make their escape.

Our assailants, a group of [from.owner.species.GetClass] aliens, have set about dissecting and butchering those parts of us they recognize as lifeforms on board the ship. Those among us who weren't ambulatory macro-symbionts seem to have met kinder fates, having merely been exterminated or expunged. None aboard remain within our chorus, though we felt their loss throughout.

An act of torture has been inflicted upon us, but even if nothing else: we now know more about the kinds of threats we face out here.

texts.zh:
我们结束了对此前抓获的[This.ContactCountry.GetName]外星人的研究。这些人质相当不愿意同我们合作，不过由于我们将其开膛破肚，他们的反抗毫无意义。我们现在对他们的[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesOrganNamePlural]、[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesEarNamePlural]和[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural]的内部功能以及其他身体部分有了更多的了解，我们的基因学家[This.Owner.GetResearchers]获得了相当有价值的异种生物学数据。

由于我们残忍的行为带来的恐怖，一部分外星人——现在我们知道他们是[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural]——开始在我们翻译他们语言并接入电脑系统时表现出了合作的态度。作为结果，我们显然拥有了数量相当可观的情报，如果有需求，我们可以部署这些情报对付他们。
texts.en:
We have concluded our study of the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] aliens we recently captured. The hostages proved unwilling to cooperate with us, but this became a moot point as we began to cut them open. We now know much about the internal functions of their [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesOrganNamePlural], [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesEarNamePlural], [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural] and other body parts, giving our genetics [This.Owner.GetResearchers] valuable xenobiological data.

Driven to terror by the cruelty of our actions, a handful of the aliens - who we now know to be [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural] - cooperated with us as we sought to translate their language and access their computer systems. As a result, we now have considerable intelligence we are able to deploy against them, should the need arise.

texts.zh:
我们已经完成了对近期捕获的[This.ContactCountry.GetName]外星生物的研究。这些为数众多的生命体以某种蜂巢思维的方式组织起来，但并没有一个中央的管理实体。相反，这些几乎不具备智慧的个体似乎与它们的整个生物群落形成了一种共生格式塔结构。

与家园以及彼此隔离后，这些共生体退化到了原始状态并迅速消亡，这使得尸检变得相当简单。现在我们已经对他们[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesOrganNamePlural]、[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesEarNamePlural]、[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural]和其他身体部位的内部功能有了很多了解，这为我们[This.Owner.GetResearchers]的遗传学家提供了宝贵的外星生物学数据。

我们现在知道如何同他们的母国，[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]，进行沟通了，并且可以部署数量相当可观的情报来对付他们——如果有必要的话。
texts.en:
We have concluded our study of the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] aliens we recently captured. This myriad assortment of lifeforms are organized as a sort of hive mind, albeit without a central, governing entity. Instead these barely-sapient individuals seem to form a mutualistic gestalt with their entire biome.

Since being isolated from each other as well as their homeworld, these symbionts reverted to a primal state and soon perished, making autopsy rather trivial. We now know much about the internal functions of their [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesOrganNamePlural], [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesEarNamePlural], [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural] and other body parts, giving our genetics [This.Owner.GetResearchers] valuable xenobiological data.

We now know how to communicate with their parent empire, the [This.ContactCountry.GetRealName], if needed - and have considerable intelligence to deploy against them should it prove necessary!

虽然花费的时间比我们预期的稍长，但凭借我们所掌握的生物学知识以及在捕获的飞船上发现的各种线索，我们最终破解了他们的语言和计算机代码。我们现在知道如何同他们的母国，[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]，进行沟通了，并且可以部署数量相当可观的情报来对付他们——如果有必要的话。
texts.en:
We have concluded our study of the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] aliens we recently captured. It would appear that they are indeed organized as a hive mind, with individual drones lacking autonomy or agency. Although they proved unuseful subjects for interrogation, this became a moot point as we began to cut them open. We now know much about the internal functions of their [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesOrganNamePlural], [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesEarNamePlural], [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural] and other body parts, giving our genetics [This.Owner.GetResearchers] valuable xenobiological data.

Though it took a bit longer than we might have hoped, the biological knowledge we had gained and the various clues scattered about the captured vessel allowed us to crack their language - and their computer codes. We now know how to communicate with their parent empire, the [This.ContactCountry.GetRealName], if needed - and have considerable intelligence to deploy against them should it prove necessary!

我们结束了对此前抓获的[This.ContactCountry.GetName]机器的研究。一旦切断同人工智能主体的联系，这些无人机就失去了执行能力，无法提供与他们自己的协议相关的信息。但是一旦我们开始将他们大卸八块，我们又可以获得一定的进展了——不仅在了解他们的内部语言方面，也在找出有关他们的更多知识方面。其结论是，他们使用的处理器还是比不过我们针对他们使用的攻性数据收集技术，现在他们已经没剩下多少秘密了。

我们现在可以同他们的人工智能主体——其自称为[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]——进行沟通，我们会静观其变。
texts.en:
We have concluded our study of the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] machines we recently captured. Once cut off from their parent AI, the drones lacked agency and gave off little useful information of their own accord, but once we began dissembling them, we were able to make more progress - both in understanding their internal functioning, and in finding out more about them. It turned out their processors were no match for the invasive data gathering techniques we used on them, with the result that little about them is now secret to us.

We can now also communicate with their parent AI - which calls itself the [This.ContactCountry.GetRealName] - should we see fit.

我们的探险家们知道第一次接触是一项很危险的事情，但谁也没想到事态会发展到这个地步。在这次暴力袭击中，[From.Owner.GetName]扣押了我们的舰船，我们还没来得及发动紧急超光速跃迁就被搜查小队登船了。尽管我们的船员做出了英勇的反抗，但袭击者——[From.Owner.Species.GetAAnSpeciesClass][From.Owner.Species.GetClass]，他们还是干烂了我们的防御。

我们船上的视觉信号现在已经切断了，但他们故意向我们展示了他们处决俘虏的画面，展示了他们对[This.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]生命的蔑视！我们必须假定，当面对一个以这种方式行事的文明时，我们必须采取强有力的敌对行动回击。
texts.en:
Our explorers knew first contact to be a dangerous affair, but none could have predicted just how true this would be. In a violent assault, the [From.Owner.GetName] seized our vessel, landing a boarding party before emergency FTL could be engaged. Despite our crew's valiant efforts, the attackers - [From.Owner.Species.GetAAnSpeciesClass] [From.Owner.Species.GetClass] alien species - were able to overwhelm our defenses.

Our visual feeds from within the ship have now cut off, but not before showing us the aliens executing all the hostages they had taken, showing no regard whatsoever for [This.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] life. We must assume that hostilities are inevitable when faced with a civilization that would act in such a manner.

texts.zh:
风险决策部分从一开始就知道第一次接触外星文明是一项很危险的事情。[From.Owner.GetName]的行动证明了他们是对的。我们的舰船被扣押了，还没来得及发动紧急超光速跃迁就被搜查小队登船了。

这群针对我们的袭击者，[From.Owner.Species.GetClass]的外星人，设法捕获了我们的许多子个体，并且已经开始不顾可能被浪费的资源，以最不合理的方式屠杀他们。这样的行为，加上他们捕获的我们的舰船和在船上使用的所有技术，他们的威胁等级需要提升到非常高的程度。

Our assailants, a group of [From.Owner.Species.GetClass] aliens, managed to capture many of our menial drones and slaughtered them in a most irrational manner, with no regard for the waste of resources. This, together with their capture of our ship and all the technologies deployed there, has caused us to significantly increase our evaluation of the danger posed by them.

label.zh: 外星人和我们心心相印。
或许他们只是太好吃了。

texts.zh: 对于在[This.ContactCountry.GetName]中俘获的飞船的研究已经结束。没能抓到一个活口使得这次调查极具挑战。不过幸运的是，他们还是留给我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]丰富的材料用以破解它们的语言，我们现在将其识别为[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]，如果我们乐意的话还能和对方进行沟通。此外，我们还能够研究它们在自己舰船上使用的科技，这能帮助我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]在研究突破上找到全新的思路。
texts.en: We have concluded our study of the vessel we recently captured from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName]. The absence of a living crew made our investigation challenging. Fortunately, they left behind enough material for our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] to gradually decipher their language and identify them as the [This.ContactCountry.GetRealName], allowing us to communicate with them should we so please. Furthermore, we were able to study their ship's technology, which has helped our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] uncover some novel new approaches to our own research problems.

Fortunately, they left behind enough material for our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] to gradually decipher their language and identify them as the [This.ContactCountry.GetRealName], allowing us to communicate with them should we so please. Furthermore, we were able to study their technology, which has helped our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] to uncover some novel new approaches to our own research problems.

note.zh: 获得 5 点情报与少量科技进度，结束首次接触。
note.en: 5 intel and a little tech progress; first contact ends.

texts.zh:
我们试图将[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的探索船无力化，然而这一行动酿成了一场血战，甚至在我们登船之后惨烈的战斗仍未停息。冲突十分激烈，没有船员幸存——似乎所有受伤的战斗人员都宁愿自杀，也不允许自己被俘。

尽管它们在最后的时间里急匆匆地抹除了电脑系统，并试图让舰船自爆，它们的舰船还是完好无损地落入了我们的手中。我方的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]正开始工作，试图从中发掘出有用的信息。
texts.en:
We were able to disable the exploratory vessel of the [This.ContactCountry.GetName], but only after a bloody firefight that continued even as we boarded their ship. So ferocious was the struggle that no living survivors remained - it seems that wounded combatants committed suicide rather than permit themselves to be captured.

Despite their hasty last-minute efforts to wipe their computer systems and rig the ship to explode, their vessel is still very much intact, and our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] are poised to see what they can find out from it.

We were able to disable the exploratory vessel of the [This.ContactCountry.GetName], but only after a bloody firefight that continued even as we boarded their ship. The crew of the ship moved with remarkable coordination - almost as if guided by a single mind - and gave a fierce struggle, refusing to back down and eventually killing themselves rather than permit themselves to be captured.

Despite their hasty last-minute efforts to wipe their computer systems and rig the ship to explode, their vessel is still very much intact, and our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] are poised to see what they can find out from it.

texts.zh:
我们成功瘫痪了来自[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的探索舰，但登舰过程中爆发的冲突意外升级为致命交火。起初这群[This.ContactCountry.Species.GetClass]外星生物展现出超乎预期的协同作战能力，宛如共享同一意识。然而当我方取得军事优势后，这些生物突然陷入全面混乱。其行为模式迅速退化为原始而野蛮的状态，完全丧失组织性，最终被迅速歼灭。

现有证据表明，这些低等智慧生物曾隶属于某个格式塔意识。那个操纵它们的未知存在显然宁可选择自我毁灭也不愿被俘获——最终留给我们的只有可回收的舰体残骸，其中充斥着嗜血野兽与蠕动的异星植被。
texts.en:
We managed to disable the exploratory vessel from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName], but only after a skirmish that became decidedly more deadly as we boarded their ship. At first the [This.ContactCountry.Species.GetClass] aliens fought with a far greater sense of coordination than we had anticipated, as though acting with one mind. However once we pressed our military advantage, the creatures suddenly lost all cohesion. From that point their behavior reverted to something primal, bestial, and entirely uncoordinated. Their end came swiftly.

We can only posit that these barely-sapient creatures were once operating as part of a gestalt. Whichever entity was guiding them seems to have favored self-destruction over capture; it left us with nought but a salvageable hull filled with ravening beasts and twitching vegetation.

label.zh: 这艘船会把它们的秘密都显露出来。
label.en: The ship will surely yield their secrets.

texts.zh:
我们的探险家们知道第一次接触是一项很危险的事情，但谁也没想到事态会发展到这个地步。在这次暴力袭击中，[From.Owner.GetName]扣押了我们的舰船，我们还没来得及发动紧急超光速跃迁就被搜查小队登船了。尽管我们的船员做出了英勇的反抗，但袭击者——[From.Owner.Species.GetAAnSpeciesClass][From.Owner.Species.GetClass]，他们还是干烂了我们的防御。

或许值得庆幸的是，无论是为了他们自己的尊严还是保护我们的情报不落入敌手，我们的船员在被俘虏之前英勇就义了。然而，我们必须假定攻击者很快就会通过研究我们的船只获取我们的情报——面对一个以这种方式行事的文明时，我们必须采取强有力的敌对行动。
texts.en:
Our explorers knew first contact to be a dangerous affair, but none could have predicted just how true this would be. In a violent assault, the [From.Owner.GetName] seized our vessel, landing a boarding party before emergency FTL could be engaged. Despite our crew's valiant efforts, the attackers - [From.Owner.Species.GetAAnSpeciesClass] [From.Owner.Species.GetClass] alien species - were able to overwhelm our defenses.

Perhaps fortunately - both for them and the sake of keeping information from enemy hands - our crew took their own lives rather than permit themselves to be captured. However, we must assume that our assailants will soon find out much about us by studying our vessel - and that hostilities are inevitable when faced with a civilization that would act in such a manner.

这群针对我们的袭击者，[From.Owner.Species.GetClass]的外星人，过载了我们的防御，为了保护我们的信息，我们发布了让我们的无人自毁的指令。然而，我们必须假定攻击者很快就会通过研究我们的船只获取我们的情报——面对一个以这种方式行事的文明时，我们必须采取强有力的敌对行动。
texts.en:
The part of us that considers threat assessments was sure from the start that encountering alien civilizations would be risky. This has proven correct with the case of one of our exploratory vessels, which was assaulted and boarded by the [From.Owner.GetName] before emergency FTL could be engaged.

Our assailants, a group of [From.Owner.Species.GetClass] aliens, were able to overwhelm our defenses, so we gave the order for our drones to decommission themselves so as to protect the security of our information. However, we must assume that our assailants will soon find out much about us by studying our vessel. As a result, we have significantly increased our evaluation of the danger posed by them.

texts.zh:
我们长久以来一直怀疑，如果星系其他地方存在生命，它们可能会对我们构成威胁，其危险程度不亚于游荡的奇点或恒星辐射。如今，这一怀疑已被证实。我们的一艘探索舰遭到[from.owner.GetName]的袭击并登舰——对方在飞船上的共生体尚未撤离时就发动了进攻。

我们的袭击者——一群[from.owner.species.GetClass]外星人——很快击溃了我们的防御，他们优先攻击了那些被其识别为生命体的部分。出于自保，我们被迫抛弃了舰上所有成员，将其隔绝于我们的意识共鸣之外。尽管来犯者如此猖獗，他们终将一无所获。

这是一次赤裸裸的侵略行径，但至少我们现在更清楚地认识到，在这片星海中还将面临何种威胁。
texts.en:
We had long suspected that if life existed elsewhere in the galaxy it may pose a threat to us, every bit as wild and lethal as rogue singularities or stellar radiation. Now though, our suspicions have proven true. One of our exploratory vessels has been assaulted and boarded by the [from.owner.GetName]; they pressed their attack before our ship-bound symbionts could make their escape.

Our assailants, a group of [from.owner.species.GetClass] aliens, soon overwhelmed our defenses, having prioritized those parts of us they actually recognized as lifeforms. As an act of self-preservation we were forced to abandon all those aboard, isolating them from our chorus. For all their aggression, our attackers shall learn little from us.

An act of naked transgression has been directed toward us, but now at least we do know more about the kinds of threats we face elsewhere in this galaxy.

tooltips.zh: 为了保证安全，我方其他位于他们领土中的舰队也发动了紧急超光速跃迁。
tooltips.en: Our other fleets in what appears to be their territory have sought safety by engaging emergency FTL.

texts.zh: 我们试图俘获[This.ContactCountry.GetName]探索船的行动最终成了一场灾难。非常不幸的是，对方的抵抗比预料中的要激烈得多。当发现战斗获胜无望以后，它们令舰船自毁了。现在除了漂浮的残骸，什么都没剩下。我们只能衷心地希望，这艘探索船的后面没有跟着一整支复仇的战舰！
texts.en: Our attempts to capture the exploratory vessel of the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] have ended in catastrophe. Unfortunately, they resisted more vigorously than expected, and once it became clear that their fight was hopeless, they set the vessel to self-destruct. Little now remains of their vessel but debris. We can only hope their exploration vessel will not be followed by warships bent on revenge!

Unfortunately, they resisted more vigorously than expected, and during the firefight, their ship sustained a critical hit. Little now remains of their vessel but debris. We can only hope their exploration vessel will not be followed by warships bent on revenge!

texts.zh:
一支有勇——但或许无谋——的秘密特殊武装小队成功从[This.ContactCountry.GetName]领地撤离并从他们[abduction_planet.System.GetName]星系的殖民地中带走了若干人质。他们在黑夜的遮蔽下降落到行星偏远的角落并抓走了几只带有大型黑白斑点的哺乳生物，而它们并没有做出任何反抗。

不久之后我们就意识到这些生物并不能发出任何具有[This.ContactCountry.GetName]通讯的声音特征，事实上也不能给出任何证明它们是感性生物的迹象。经过进一步调查，我们得出结论，我们意外地抓获了他们牲畜的样本！

不幸的是，在这次行动之后他们的太空巡逻部队提高了警戒，说明他们已经探测到了我们的存在——使得我们任何未来的尝试计划都只能惨遭失败……
texts.en:
A brave - but perhaps not very bright - team of covert special forces has escaped [This.ContactCountry.GetName] territory with hostages captured from one of their colonies in the [abduction_planet.System.GetName] system. They were able to land on a remote part of the planet in the cover of darkness and seize several specimens of a large, black and white speckled mammalian creature, which did not resist.

Only later did we realize that these creatures were not making any of the sounds characteristic of [This.ContactCountry.GetName] transmissions, nor indeed giving any indication whatsoever of being sentient. Upon further investigation, we concluded that we had accidentally captured examples of their livestock!

Unfortunately, their space patrols have stepped up in vigilance since the raid, indicating that they have detected our presence - making any further attempts be doomed to failure...

尽管行动没有出错，我们的特工摆脱了追兵成功逃离，但是要想[This.ContactCountry.GetName]对我们的行动没有丝毫察觉似乎是不可能的。

texts.zh: 尽管有些人早在担忧未知外星人舰船闯入我们的宇域一事，[From.Owner.GetName]表现出来的威胁直到刚刚才昭然若揭。他们似乎在[abduction_planet.GetName]的一个偏远地区登陆了一支秘密行动小队，还绑架了几个活的[This.Owner.GetSpeciesName]人质，在我们能够组织起一支救援小队之前就逃遁到了深空。我们只能想象这些人质在他们的捕捉者手里会遭到何等的折磨。
texts.en: While some were worried at the incursion of unknown alien vessels into our space, it was not clear until now just how much of a threat the [From.Owner.GetName] posed. It seems they landed a covert team on a remote part of [abduction_planet.GetName] and seized living [This.Owner.GetSpeciesName] hostages, escaping into the depths of space before we could mount a rescue party. We can only imagine what tortures they will suffer at the hands of their captors.

It seems they sent a covert force to intercept one of our cargo vessels in the [abduction_system.GetName] system, seizing the ship and escaping into the depths of space before we could mount a rescue party. We can only imagine what tortures the crew will suffer at the hands of their captors.

texts.zh: 我们将允许未知外星人进入我们宇域一事评估为风险——现在这项评估被证明为是正确的。似乎[From.Owner.GetName]在[abduction_planet.GetName]的一个偏远地区登陆了一支秘密行动小队，然后捕获了几个[This.Owner.GetSpeciesName]无人机，还有一些我们的硬件设备，在我们能够组织起一支小队摧毁他们之前就逃遁到了深空。我们只能希望他们从带走的东西那里找不到太多的价值。
texts.en: We had assessed allowing unknown aliens into our space to be a risk - an assessment which has proven correct. It seems the [From.Owner.GetName] landed a covert team on a remote part of [abduction_planet.GetName] and seized several [This.Owner.GetSpeciesName] drones, along with some of our hardware, escaping into the depths of space before we could send a party to destroy them. We can only hope they will be unable to find out much of value from what they have taken.

texts.zh:
我们早已怀疑允许未知外星物种进入我方宇域会带来重大风险，如今事实证明我们的担忧不无道理。[From.Owner.GetName]显然找到了隐秘登陆[abduction_planet.GetName]地表的方法，他们隔离并劫持了数名共生体后，便遁入太空深处。其行动之诡谲，令我们完全无力阻止。

对于这桩卑劣的侵犯行径，我们深感耻辱与痛惜。但值得稍感宽慰的是，这些掠夺者从窃取的样本中榨取不了多少价值。
texts.en:
We had suspected that allowing unknown aliens into our space would carry significant risks, and we now know we were right to be concerned. It seems the [From.Owner.GetName] found a way to covertly land a team on our surface at [abduction_planet.GetName], isolating and abducting several symbionts before fleeing into the depths of space. Such was their subterfuge, we were powerless to intervene.

We feel the shame and loss of this foul transgression, however we may also take small comfort from knowing the raiders will not glean much value from what they have stolen.

texts.zh: 我们将允许未知外星人进入我们宇域一事评估为风险——现在这项评估被证明为是正确的。似乎[From.Owner.GetName]派出了一支秘密行动小队拦截了一艘我们位于[abduction_system.GetName]星系的补给舰，扣押的这艘舰船，在我们能够组织起一支小队摧毁他们之前就逃遁到了深空。我们只能希望他们从带走的东西那里找不到太多的价值。

texts.zh: 我们计划绑架几个人质进行审问的行动成了一场灾难！一支由[This.Leader.GetName]领导的英勇的秘密特种部队试图在[This.ContactCountry.GetName]位于[abduction_planet.System.GetName]星系的一个殖民地上登陆。然而，一旦他们着陆之后我们立马就失去了联络。在当前这个阶段，我们不能指望他们有什么逃脱追捕的希望。不幸的是，我们永远没法知道他们是被留作了活口，还是在外星人手上经受长达数小时的折磨之后被处决。
texts.en: Our attempt to seize hostages for interrogation has gone disastrously! A brave team of covert special forces led by [This.Leader.GetName] attempted to land on a [This.ContactCountry.GetName] colony in the [abduction_planet.System.GetName] system. However, we lost contact with them soon after they landed. At this stage, we can no longer hold out any hope that they escaped capture. Unfortunately, we may never know whether they were taken alive, or whether they were spared long hours of torture at the hands of aliens by the swift release of death.

texts.zh: 我们计划绑架几个人质进行审问的行动成了一场灾难！一批主导秘密行动的无人机，由[This.Leader.GetName]管控，试图降落在一个[This.ContactCountry.GetName]位于[abduction_planet.System.GetName]星系的殖民地上。然而，一旦他们着陆之后我们立马就失去了联络。在当前这个阶段，我们必须假设他们要么被俘虏要么被摧毁。不幸的是，我们永远无法直到他们在永久报废之前，敌人会从他们身上榨取何等的情报。
texts.en: Our attempt to seize hostages for interrogation has gone disastrously! A detachment of covert operations drones led by [This.Leader.GetName] attempted to land on a [This.ContactCountry.GetName] colony in the [abduction_planet.System.GetName] system. However, we lost contact with them soon after they landed. At this stage, we must assume that they were either captured or destroyed. Unfortunately, we may never know what information the enemy might have gleaned from them before their eventual demise.

texts.zh: 我们计划绑架几个人质进行审问的行动成了一场灾难！一支由[This.Leader.GetName]带领的隶属于秘密特种部队的英勇小队尝试在[abduction_system.GetName]星系获取一个[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的货船。然而他们并没有意识到他们选择的目标比预期的具有更好的武装——也没有意识到地方周边还隐藏着数艘战舰。在仓促的撤退中，他们的船只被摧毁了。
texts.en: Our attempt to seize hostages for interrogation has gone disastrously! A brave team of covert special forces led by [This.Leader.GetName] attempted to seize a [This.ContactCountry.GetName] cargo vessel in the [abduction_system.GetName] system. However, they did not realize that their chosen target was better-armed than anticipated - nor that the enemy had several warships concealed nearby. Their ship was destroyed along with all hands as they sought a hasty retreat.

texts.zh: 我们计划绑架几个人质进行审问的行动成了一场灾难！一批主导秘密行动的无人机，由[This.Leader.GetName]管控，打算在[abduction_system.GetName]星系劫持一艘[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的补给舰。然而，他们选择的目标武装水平比先前预估的要高，他们也没有预估到周边还有几艘藏匿的战舰。无人机的舰船在仓促撤退时被摧毁。
texts.en: Our attempt to seize hostages for interrogation has gone disastrously! A detachment of covert operations drones led by [This.Leader.GetName] attempted to seize a small [This.ContactCountry.GetName] logistics vessel in the [abduction_system.GetName] system. However, they did not realize that their chosen target was better-armed than anticipated - nor that the enemy had several warships concealed nearby. Their ship was destroyed as they sought a hasty retreat.

tooltips.zh: 我们位于他们领土的舰队开始逃脱以躲避报复打击。
tooltips.en: Our fleets in their territory have fled to avoid reprisals.

texts.zh:
尽管有些人早在担忧未知外星人舰船闯入我们的宇域一事，[From.Owner.GetName]表现出来的威胁直到刚刚才昭然若揭。他们似乎在[abduction_planet.GetName]的一个偏远地区登陆了一支秘密行动小队，打算绑架了几个人质；然而，得益于我们的早期预警系统，我们能够部署自己的特种部队切断他们的逃跑路线。他们下次还想玩这种蠢把戏的时候会三思的！

似乎针对我们的攻击者——一群[From.Owner.GetSpeciesClass]外星人——被命令了结自己的生命而不是让他们自己被俘虏，但是这样的情况当然也给予了我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]丰富的材料以供调查。
texts.en:
While some were worried at the incursion of unknown alien vessels into our space, it was not clear until now just how much of a threat the [From.Owner.GetName] posed. It seems they landed a covert team on a remote part of [abduction_planet.GetName] to attempt to seize hostages for interrogation; however, thanks to our early warning systems, we were able to deploy our own special forces to cut off their escape. They will surely think twice before pulling a stunt like this again!

It seems our assailants - a group of [From.Owner.GetSpeciesClass] aliens - were under orders to take their own lives rather than allow themselves to be captured, but this incident has certainly given our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] abundant material to investigate.

It seems our assailants - a group of mechanical drones, perhaps guided by a rogue AI - were under orders to destroy themselves rather than allow themselves to be captured, but this incident has certainly given our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] abundant material to investigate.

texts.zh:

敌方船只在试图逃跑的时候被摧毁了，但是那里依旧可能有一些有用的信息。
texts.en:
While some were worried at the incursion of unknown alien vessels into our space, it was not clear until now just how much of a threat the [From.Owner.GetName] posed. It seems they sent a covert force to intercept one of our cargo vessels in the [abduction_system.GetName] system; however, in a stroke of fortune, we had several warships concealed nearby that were able to arrive on the scene quickly.

The enemy vessel was destroyed as it sought to escape, but its remains may yet yield some useful information.

texts.zh:

似乎敌方——一群[From.Owner.GetSpeciesClass]外星人——被命令自杀而不是让他们自己被俘虏，但是这个事故毫无疑问也给予了我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]丰富的材料以供调查。

They will surely think twice before pulling a stunt like this again!

It seems the enemy - a group of [From.Owner.GetSpeciesClass] aliens - were given the command to take their own lives rather than allow themselves to be captured, but this incident has certainly given our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] abundant material to investigate.

texts.zh:
我们早就知道允许未知外星种族进入我们的宇域会带来重大风险，现在事实证明我们的担忧完全正确。[From.Owner.GetName]几乎成功将一支小队秘密降落在[abduction_planet.GetName]地表，企图绑架多名共生体并窃取我们的技术。但他们严重低估了我们高度互联的特性。当这些入侵者违反协议的行为被识破时，立即遭到了猛烈反击。

这支由[From.Owner.GetSpeciesClass]外星人组成的敌袭小队在行动失败后，似乎接到了自毁指令以避免被俘。尽管如此，这次入侵事件仍为我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]提供了大量可供研究的样本材料。
texts.en:
We knew allowing unknown aliens into our space would carry significant risks, and now we know how right we were to be concerned. The [From.Owner.GetName] almost found a way to covertly land a team on our surface at [abduction_planet.GetName], intent on abducting several symbionts and seizing our technology. However, they did not properly account for our intraconnected nature. The would-be raiders met with fierce opposition as soon as we recognized their violation.

It seems the enemy - a group of [From.Owner.GetSpeciesClass] aliens - were commanded to take their own lives rather than allow themselves to be captured, but in spite of that: this incursion has given our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] abundant material with which to investigate them.

It seems our assailants - a group of mechanical drones, perhaps guided by an AI like our own [This.Owner.GetGovernmentName] - were under orders to destroy themselves rather than allow themselves to be captured, but this incident has certainly given our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] abundant material to investigate.

我们将允许未知外星人进入我们宇域一事评估为风险——现在这项评估被证明为是正确的。似乎[From.Owner.GetName]派遣了一支秘密行动部队在[abduction_system.GetName]星系拦截了我们的一艘后勤船只；然而碰巧的是，我们刚好在附近有数艘隐蔽的战舰能够快速地到达现场。

texts.zh: 我们派去调查[From.Owner.GetName]的一艘飞船被对方的武装力量的暴力袭击所摧毁。现在还不清楚他们究竟是想截获我们的船只，还是只是想简单地给我们一个警告让我们离开他们的领土。
texts.en: A vessel we had sent to investigate the [From.Owner.GetName] was destroyed in a violent assault by their forces. It is unclear whether they sought to capture our vessel, or whether they simply sought to give us the message to keep away from their territory.

tooltips.zh: 为了保证安全，我方其他位于他们领土中的舰队也发动了紧急超光速跃迁。
tooltips.en: Our other fleets in what appears to be their territory have sought safety by engaging emergency FTL.

texts.en: Our efforts to capture the exploratory vessel of the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] have ended in failure. Unfortunately, we lost track of their ship before we could attempt to seize it.

texts.zh: 我们试图俘获[This.ContactCountry.GetName]探索船的行动失败了。非常的不幸，它们成功地躲避了我们的俘虏行动，并在我们将舰船无力化之前就逃脱了恒星系。我们的未来乌云密布——不仅是因为要找出它们的信息更加困难艰巨了，也是因为它们一定会将这次行动当作我们敌视它们的一部分。
texts.en: Our efforts to capture the exploratory vessel of the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] have ended in failure. Unfortunately, they managed to elude our capture attempt and escape the system before we could disable their ship. This bodes ill for the future - not only do we face an uphill struggle to find out more about them, but they will surely consider this to be a hostile act on our part.

label.zh: 我们现在必须加把劲翻译它们的语言了。
label.en: We must redouble our efforts to translate their language.

# 外星飞船被俘获！ / Alien Ship Captured!（敌对首次接触 hostile first contact）
- 分类 Category：文明纪事 Society (C7) · 首次接触阶段链 first-contact stage chain（首个事件 first_contact.250）
- 来源 Sources：`events/first_contact_events.txt:2379–5410` · `common/first_contact/00_first_contact.txt:1134–1545`
- 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-13（c7b-society）

## 如何开始 How it starts

当“允许攻击”政策的本方在第一阶段事件（5/10/20/25）选择攻击，阶段设为 default_hostile_ship_stage（难度2）；在 15（已知有人居住的系统）选择攻击则进入 default_hostile_systems_stage（绑架）。/ With the attack-allowed policy, the attack option of the stage-1 events (5/10/20/25) enters the hostile-ship stage; in 15 (inhabited systems known) it enters the hostile-systems (abduction) stage.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

1. **夺船**（敌对飞船阶段）按权重得到一个结果：**250 外星飞船被俘获！**（带船员）/ **260** 俘获但无幸存者 / **270 空壳**（飞船自毁）/ **280 失败**（对方逃脱）。/ One outcome of the ship capture.
2. **250** 选项：审问、活体解剖、灭口/吞食；对方分别收到 252/253/254。**260** → 无船员收尾，对方收到 262。**270**、**280** 的“再试一次”→ 绑架阶段；对方可收到 272 / 282。/ Captors choose; failures can retry via abduction.
3. **绑架**（敌对系统阶段）：**320 外星人被俘获**（成功，选项同 250）、**330 绑架失败**、**321 一次不幸的失误**；对方收到 322 / 332。/ Abduction outcomes 320 / 330 / 321.
4. 收尾：**285 审讯完成**、**290 外星研究完成**（活体解剖）、**295 外星材料研究**（无活口）。/ End events 285 / 290 / 295.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 夺船结果 250/260/270/280 互斥；绑架结果 320/330/321 互斥；处置俘虏 285/290/295 互斥。/ Exclusive sets.
- 285/290/295 之后调用 finish_first_contact_effect；若对方也有反向接触，30 天后会收到 1100/1105/1110（见各自单页）。/ 285/290/295 finish first contact; the victim receives 1100/1105/1110 30 days later via reverse first contact.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

250/252–254 有多物种、机械受害者、蜂巢受害者、荒野受害者等文本；选项C仅灭绝倾向可见，吞噬蜂群有专门选项。/ Many text variants by victim type; option C needs homicidal ethics, devouring swarms get a dedicated option.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对 Checked：250–332 脚本、敌对飞船/系统阶段、五个“敌对收尾”阶段。
- 审阅改动 Changes：原 250（夺船）与 320（绑架）两篇并为一棵树（270/280 的“再试一次”本来就通向绑架），并把共享收尾 285/290/295 收为章节；1100/1105/1110 作为反向接触单页保留。/ The separate ship-capture and abduction stories (250 and 320) are now one tree because the retry options lead from one to the other; the shared end events 285/290/295 are chapters.
